data.one_liner: Edit image data with native Android, iOS, and macOS code and output to file or memory.
data.what_it_does: Processes images using native platform code to perform actions like cropping, rotating, scaling, flipping, color adjustments, text overlay, drawing, and merging multiple images.
use_when: You need to perform high-performance image manipulation (crop, rotate, scale) using native code.
You want to draw shapes, text, or merge multiple images programmatically into memory or a file.
avoid_when: You only need simple image loading and network caching.
You need pure Dart image manipulation without native platform dependencies.
strengths: Uses native code (objc, kotlin, arkts) for fast image processing.
Supports a wide range of editing options including flip, crop, rotate, scale, color matrix, text addition, and drawing.
Supports multi-image merging and blending modes.
weaknesses: Gaussian blur is not supported on Android and iOS according to the feature support table.
Matrix operations are not supported on OpenHarmony.
data.setup_notes: Add the dependency to pubspec.yaml. No extra setup notes documented.

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose image if you need a pure Dart image processing library without native platform plugins.

alternatives.name: flutter_image_compress
alternatives.why_pick_it: Choose flutter_image_compress if your primary goal is high-performance image compression.
